thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — adaptive sampler audit flagged a big drop in coverage for 'rare-intent' buckets after the last dedupe pass. noticed 4.7% -> 0.8% on sampled holdouts.

ashwin: Ugh. Which sweep? full daily or the overnight priority sweep?

maya: overnight priority sweep (run id `sweep-2026-03-18-23`). Looks like the overlap filter removed a lot of low-frequency paraphrases.

kevin: Do we have examples? can you paste a few non-sensitive snippets?

maya: sure — pasted 3 sanitized examples below:
```
1) "How do I redact PII in uploads?" -> class: support_reid
2) "Can I disable chat history per user?" -> class: account_prefs
3) "What are the retention windows for logs?" -> class: compliance_retention
```

zara: those look legitimately rare. were they flagged as duplicates to higher-frequency templates?

labeler-bot: Routing report: 47 items from rare-intent bucket forwarded to `fallback-labeler-queue` after dedupe. 12 already labeled; 35 pending.

ashwin: hmm, fallback queue backlog growing. we had the fallback threshold at entropy < 0.12 and overlap Jaccard > 0.6. maybe those thresholds are too aggressive for low-support intents.

kevin: proposed fix: add an exception for classes with less than 500 examples — skip aggressive overlap dedupe and keep one sample per unique paraphrase. also lower the entropy gate for those classes to 0.08 before routing to fallback.

maya: that sounds reasonable. will need to update sampler config and rerun a targeted backfill.

zara: also worth checking golden coverage: if these intents are in golden, we need to preserve them and mark rerun priority high so they don't get overwritten by dedupe. otherwise new model bring-up (q8b-x) won't surface these edge cases.

kevin: +1. action items: 1) ashwin update sampler config (skip aggressive dedupe for <500 classes) 2) maya request backfill run and mark high-priority for golden audit 3) zara verify golden holdout doesn't lose examples.

ashwin: will do. pushing a small patch now and kicking off a dry-run. config diff: 
```yaml
sampler:
  overlap_threshold: 0.6
  entropy_gate: 0.12
  exceptions:
    min_class_count: 500
    dedupe_mode_for_small_classes: keep_one_per_paraphrase
```

ops-bot: Deploy started for `sampler-config/patch-3532100000` — dry-run mode enabled.

labeler-bot: Noted. created `fallback-labeler-queue` subtask: #8732 with 35 pending. assigned to label_ops team.

maya: thanks. once dry-run looks clean, can we run a small canary: 5k samples through new sampler + run eval suite vs current model to check recall regression? want a quick baseline before full backfill.

kevin: yes — plan: canary -> run evals (recall by intent, confusion matrix) -> compare with current model and quantized variant (q6b-quant) to see if quantization amplifies recall loss.

zara: I'll take the eval side and prepare the canary prompt sets. label_ops: if you can prioritize the 35 pending that'd let us validate label stability.

labeler-bot: Assigned priority "urgent" to those 35 examples and added a small golden-check flag for any label changes.

maya: perfect. ping me when dry-run completes or if the bot shows any failures. thanks everyone :rocket:
